# cleura_openstack_user (Data Source)

Fetches an **OpenStack user** (a Keystone user) in your Cleura account by `id` or by `name`.
Use it to reference a user that is managed outside this configuration, for example to look
up a service account's ID.

The lookup is scoped to one OpenStack domain: by default the domain that serves the
provider's `region`, or `domain_id` when set. A `name` lookup is exact.

OpenStack users are distinct from Cleura account users; this data source does not need
`project_id` on the provider.

-> **Domains:** the domain this resource lives in is derived from the provider's `region`; see
[OpenStack projects, users and domains](../guides/openstack-identity.md) for how that works and
when to set `domain_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch an OpenStack user by name (scoped to the domain serving the provider's
# region) ...
data "cleura_openstack_user" "by_name" {
  name = "ci-deployer"
}

# ... or by ID.
data "cleura_openstack_user" "by_id" {
  id = "6f1c0e6f2b1d4c0aa1b2c3d4e5f60718"
}

output "ci_user_enabled" {
  value = data.cleura_openstack_user.by_name.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) OpenStack domain to search. Defaults to the account's domain that serves the provider's `region` (or the account's only domain).
- `id` (String) OpenStack user ID to fetch. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) User name to fetch, matched exactly within the domain. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `default_project_id` (String) The user's default OpenStack project, if Cleura has assigned one.
- `description` (String) User description, if any.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can log in.
